settings.question: What is OweK?
settings.answer: OweK is a financing platform for private school and camp tuition. Instead of paying the full bill at once, families can split tuition into manageable monthly payments — while the school or camp gets paid in full, upfront.

settings.question: Is OweK a lender?
settings.answer: OweK isn’t a lender. We partner with a licensed financial institution that provides the financing, while OweK handles the application, plan options, and payments.

settings.question: How much will I be able to finance?
settings.answer: The amount you’re eligible to finance depends on your application and is generally based on your tuition or camp fee. You’ll see your specific options after applying — there’s no cost or commitment to check.

settings.question: Will checking my options affect my credit?
settings.answer: No. Checking your eligibility uses a soft check that does not affect your credit score.

settings.question: When will OweK launch?
settings.answer: We’re building now and onboarding our first school and camp partners. Join the waitlist to be the first to know when OweK is available in your area.

settings.question: Can my school or camp offer OweK?
settings.answer: Yes. Schools and camps can partner with OweK to offer flexible payment options to families at no cost to enroll as a partner. Reach out through “Become a launch partner” to learn more.
